Description: Before the night ends, Victoria Maseko is sleeping alone in her room when sudden piano music wakes her; she immediately senses something is wrong and begins calling out for others.
Location: Victoria Maseko’s room (Victoria's room)
Key Information:
  - At time 14, Victoria Maseko is asleep alone in her own room.
  - Piano music suddenly starts and jolts Victoria Maseko awake.
  - The piano piece echoes music that appeared earlier, implying deliberate human action rather than incidental noise.
  - After waking, Victoria Maseko is visibly panicked, immediately gets out of bed, and starts shouting for others.
  - This node occurs before the major dawn incident and serves as a direct omen of the abnormal behavior to come.
Characters:
  [Victoria Maseko (Victoria)] Person No. 7.
    · Sleeps alone in her room.
    · Is awakened by piano music and realizes something is abnormal.
    · Gets up and calls out for others.
